name: framer-multi-carousel
title: Framer Multi Carousel
description: A row of image cards with a caption strip along the bottom, advanced one card at a time by overlay arrows. The visible count follows the window: one card on phones, three on desktops.
use: Several images with short captions should sit side by side and the count should adapt to width.
avoid: Cards cannot be dragged, the row is fixed at 300px tall and captions never truncate.
a11y: Arrows are icon-only with no accessible name, and alt text repeats the odd caption instead of describing the photo. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three portrait photo cards stand shoulder to shoulder, each around 300px tall with softly rounded corners. A black fading band across the bottom of each card holds a small white caption. Two white chevron circles float over the middle of the left and right edges.
behaves: Clicking an arrow slides the row by exactly one card with a spring, and the arrow dims to grey at either end of the set. Resizing the window changes how many cards fit, snapping the row back into range.
customise: The breakpoints prop sets cards per width; photos, captions and the fixed card height are edited in the file.
weight: light: Eighteen images in a row, moved by a single spring transform on arrow clicks.
